column1: # catalog/pr-self-check.tsv — the pre-review self-check's rules (BH-5798).
# bin/lib/pr-self-check.sh reads one row per rule; a rule with no row is off.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   id      the rule bin/lib/pr-self-check.sh knows by this name
#   mode    refuse (a finding blocks the lead review request) | note (said, never
#           blocks) | off
#   param   comma-separated globs of paths the rule ignores, or `-`
#   what    one line for the operator
#   match   (body-* rules only, BH-5790) what the PR body must show, as
#           `;`-separated alternatives: `section=<ERE>` (a heading matching the
#           ERE, case-insensitive, with 3 or more words under it), `line=<ERE>`
#           (a body line matching it) or `table` (a markdown table).
# For the body-* rules, param is WHEN the rule applies, as `;`-separated
# triggers: `always`, `added=<globs>` (the diff adds a matching file),
# `touched=<globs>` (the diff changes one), `knob` (the diff adds an "env" knob in
# catalog/lanes.d/*.json) or `ticket=<ERE>` (the linked issue's Done when or
# acceptance section matches; no ticket text = a NOTE, never a refusal).
# The body-* rows are #5790's PR-body section lint. body-mutation and body-d1
# are `note` (2026-10-10): they would have held 18 of the last 24 merged PRs, so
# they go into the lead review notes instead and hold nothing. Promote a row to
# `refuse` from data if the block-learning loop (#5794) shows the category still
# causes BLOCKs.
closes-not-met
column4: Closes/Fixes/Resolves #N while an acceptance item is marked not met (- [ ], "not met", REFUTED)

column1: evidence-head
column4: an evidence sha in the body that is not the head, or an ancestor whose PR files changed after it

column1: plan-files
column4: a diff file the plan's "Files to touch" does not name, with no line under "## Files outside the plan"

column1: test-ownership
column4: an edit to another ticket's test file (tests/*.<other-key>-test.sh) with no TEST-CHANGE: line naming it and the premise (BH-6392, D51)

column1: foreign-commits
column4: a first-parent commit whose subject leads with another ticket's key, on a PR not based on that ticket's branch and not STACKED_WAIT (BH-6394, D66)

column1: body-why
column4: a `## Why` section that says why the change exists

column1: body-acceptance
column4: an acceptance-test section or a gate table

column1: body-mutation
column4: mutation or red-first evidence for each new test suite

column1: body-schema-stamp
column4: a line saying why a new schema.d fragment uses a picked NNNN number: off since BH-6192, because the rules pack (schema-fragment-name) refuses every new NNNN fragment; a new fragment is <yyyymmddhhmm>-<ticket-key>-<name>.sql (BH-5788)

column1: body-d1
column4: a D1 / kill-knob callout: what turns this off with no deploy

column1: body-live-probe
column4: the live probe output the ticket names
